Additionally, it features other investment opportunities related to the AI energy boom, tariffs, nuclear power, and a debt-free company with significant cash reserves.

title: Inside Information: NVIDIA to make USD 1.0 billion equity investment in Nokia in addition to new strategic partnership – Nokia’s Board resolved on directed share issuance to NVIDIA
summary: Nokia's Board of Directors has approved a directed share issuance to NVIDIA, facilitating a USD 1.0 billion equity investment by NVIDIA in Nokia. This investment, which makes NVIDIA a 2.90% shareholder, comes alongside a new strategic partnership focused on advancing AI-RAN and data center networking solutions. Nokia plans to utilize the proceeds to accelerate its strategic initiatives in AI-driven connectivity and expand its presence in the AI & Cloud market.

title: AKAM - Akamai Inference Cloud Transforms AI from Core to Edge with NVIDIA
summary: Akamai Technologies launched Akamai Inference Cloud, a platform designed to extend AI inference from core data centers to the internet's edge. This new platform, leveraging NVIDIA Blackwell AI infrastructure, aims to provide scalable, secure, and low-latency AI inference globally, powering advanced Agentic and Physical AI applications. By bringing AI processing closer to users and devices, Akamai seeks to enable real-time decision-making and personalized digital experiences.

title: Schwab U.S. Dividend Quality ETF (SCHD) Offers Higher Yield While Fidelity High Dividend ETF (FDVV) Leans Into Tech
summary: This article compares two dividend-focused ETFs, Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD) and Fidelity High Dividend ETF (FDVV), highlighting their differing sector allocations, expense ratios, and dividend yields. summary: Palantir and Nvidia have formed a strategic partnership to integrate Nvidia's advanced computing technologies with Palantir's AI platform to create sophisticated AI agents and automate business processes. summary: Broadcom, IBD's Stock Of The Day, has broken out past its buy point, driven by AI activity. summary: Uber Technologies, Inc. is partnering with NVIDIA to develop and deploy one of the world's largest networks of autonomous vehicles, powered by NVIDIA AI Architecture. summary: Synopsys is showcasing its advancements in agentic AI, accelerated computing, and AI physics at NVIDIA GTC Washington, D.C., demonstrating enhanced engineering solutions from silicon to systems. summary: Palantir and Nvidia have formed a strategic partnership to integrate Nvidia's advanced computing technologies with Palantir's AI platform, aiming to create a comprehensive technology stack for enterprises. summary: HP Enterprise (HPE) is partnering with the U.S. Department of Energy to supply two advanced supercomputers, "Mission" and "Vision," as part of a $370 million initiative for scientific research, AI advancement, and national security. title: Apple, Microsoft hit $4T milestone
summary: Apple and Microsoft have both reached the $4 trillion market capitalization milestone, joining Nvidia in this exclusive club. This achievement is driven by strong performance, with Apple's iPhone 17 fueling its momentum and Microsoft benefiting from its deal with OpenAI and advancements in AI. The strong performance of these tech giants is also contributing to record highs for the Dow, Nasdaq, and S&P 500.

title: NVIDIA Makes the World Robotaxi-Ready With Uber Partnership to Support Global Expansion
summary: NVIDIA has partnered with Uber to make the world "robotaxi-ready," leveraging NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Hyperion 10 to support Uber's global autonomous fleet expansion to 100,000 vehicles by 2027. The collaboration includes developing a joint AI data factory and expanding the Level 4 autonomous ecosystem with partners like Stellantis, Lucid, and Mercedes-Benz for passenger mobility, and Aurora, Volvo Autonomous Solutions, and Waabi for long-haul freight. NVIDIA also launched the Halos Certified Program to evaluate and certify physical AI safety for autonomous vehicles.

title: Lilly partners with NVIDIA to build the industry's most powerful AI supercomputer, supercharging medicine discovery and delivery for patients
summary: Eli Lilly and Company is partnering with NVIDIA to build the pharmaceutical industry's most powerful AI supercomputer to accelerate medicine discovery and delivery. This "AI factory" will leverage NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD technology to train AI models on vast datasets, transforming drug discovery, development, manufacturing, and personalized medicine. The initiative aims to enhance scientific collaboration and bring new medicines to patients faster, operating on 100% renewable electricity within Lilly's existing facilities.
